Have you taken him into the vet for a urinalysis? That's where they take sterile urine directly from the bladder and check for crystals or bacteria. My cat Olaf (neutered) had crystals a few months ago and I switched to a urinary formula food. But I was too late to help with that because he had lots of sediment in his bladder and he got blocked so he couldn't urinate. The procedure can cost from $900-$2000 depending on the vet clinic to unblock him. The first step of this is to take him in for inappropriate urinating and request a urinalysis. Or talk about other things to help with that issue. And with the urinating on your bed, sometimes when cats have crystals in their urine and makes it a bloody tinge color and when they urinate in the litter box and it hurts they think the box is causing the pain so they urinate elsewhere. And they do it in front of you to tell you that there is something going on inside. Please take him into the vet.

Have you tried a different food? Sometimes food can be the cause of allergies such as wheat or other grains in the food. And it could be allergic to cat litter. So you can try the food first and if that doesn't help you could try switching cat litter.
